cards.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Banish (face-down) the top card of your Deck. You can only use each of the following effects of "Xenovader△ of Emptiness Gehenna" once per turn. If this card is in your hand and you control no monsters: You can Special Summon this card. During your Main Phase: You can add up to 2 of your face-down banished "Xenovader△" monsters with different names to your hand, except "Xenovader△ of Emptiness Gehenna", also you cannot activate cards or effects for the rest of this turn, except "Xenovader△" cards or effects.

cards.name: Emptiness Devouring Xenovader△ Jahannam
cards.desc:
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Banish (face-down) the top 8 cards of your Deck. Gains these effects based on the total number of face-down banished cards.
● 10+: Cannot be destroyed by battle.
● 20+: Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 card on the field; destroy it.
● 30+: Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: You can add 1 of your face-down banished cards to your hand.
● 40+: Skip both players' Draw Phases.

During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon 1 "Trirealm Rift" monster, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set (you can only gain this effect once per turn). You can only use this effect of "Trirealm Rift Gospel" once per turn.
